$comment: Reviewed canonical policy for the verified dependency-bundle trust chain. See docs/architecture/dependency-bundle-trust.md for the full trust model. A consumer reads THIS file from the verified trusted-workflow commit (github.sha of the producer/binder workflow run, itself pinned to protected main) -- NEVER from a candidate PR checkout, which could edit this file to name itself as trusted.

repository.id_status: RESOLVED -- 1141216651 is the immutable numeric GitHub repository ID for michaelayoade/dotmac_erp, read from the GitHub API (`gh api repos/michaelayoade/dotmac_erp --jq .id`) on 2026-09-13. It is checked ALONGSIDE full_name, not instead of it: a full_name survives a rename or transfer while the numeric ID never does, so verifying both means a policy binding cannot be satisfied by a different repository that briefly held this name. scripts/dependency_bundle.py::load_policy() refuses this file if id is not a positive integer.
